name: AlphaX POS Store Credit
description: Money the business owes a customer: refund-to-credit, deposits, gift value. NOT loyalty points — points are a marketing accrual, store credit is a real liability that belongs in the GL and must survive an audit. Balance is always the sum of its entries; the field here is a cache.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: On Hold blocks redemption but keeps the balance — for a disputed refund. Closed requires a zero balance.

fields.label: Card / Voucher Code
fields.description: Optional. Printed or scanned code for a physical gift card. Blank means the credit is held against the customer record only.

fields.label: Expires On
fields.description: Unredeemed value after this date can be written back to income by the expiry job. Leave blank for no expiry — which several jurisdictions require for cash refunds.

fields.label: Balance
fields.description: Cache. Recomputed from the entries on every movement; never written to directly.

fields.label: Liability Account
fields.description: Where the outstanding balance sits. Money taken now for goods later is a liability, not income — booking it as income overstates revenue and is a standard audit finding. Blank uses the company default set in AlphaX POS Settings.
